messages:
maya: kicking off a short sync to pin down the private-deploy onramp checklist (VPC/onprem). want practical preflight + upgrade rules.

sam: field wants copy-paste network examples (CIDR, egress NAT, LB modes) and a safe patch path that avoids downtime.

olivia: add explicit guidance for 'customer-managed LB' vs 'redwood ingress' - different DNS and firewall expectations.

jack: security ask: avoid hostNetwork by default; offer hostNetwork as opt-in with explicit docs.

maya: strong opinion: GA default = operator without hostNetwork; doc will show tradeoffs and port-forward options.

emily: netops preflight should include: CIDR sample, BGP snippet, cert rollout steps, and a tiny smoke-test script.

sam: propose `preflight.sh` that checks metadata, LB port, and simple throughput. print remediation hints.

olivia: add a kubectl CR health check snippet and RBAC example so customers can lock operator permissions.

maya: upgrades: manual by default for GA, opt-in auto-upgrade for customers who accept telemetry. include rolling-canary steps.

jack: also add rollback steps: drain leaders, restore previous bundle, warm KV cache. keep commands explicit.

emily: collect BGP templates (Arista/Cisco) and a minimal NAT example for netops. customers love paste-ready samples.

maya: fallback policy: if catalog unreachable, runtime switches to pinned local model bundle. doc size and checksum checks called out.

sam: launch checklist suggestion: preflight + script, upgrade+rollback docs, 3 reference validations across different network shapes, support runbook, BGP samples.

olivia: audit log requirement for peering/cert events for compliance buyers.

jack: troubleshooting matrix: DNS, MTU, TLS/KMS one-line checks.

maya: i'll draft the doc and post link. tagging @deploy-bot to open QA ticket for reference validations.

deploy-bot: [automation] created ticket PROD-ONRAMP-901 assigned to sam for reference validations. due 2024-06-12.

sam: once ticket exists we schedule acme corp validation.

maya: timeline: draft Fri, review Mon, field sprint Wed. anything else?

sam: include expected canary SLAs and telemetry hooks (p50/p95, error rates).

olivia: include RBAC policy examples.

maya: will do, thanks everyone.
